mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces discount rates, increasing present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) signals weak labor demand, reducing investor confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in slack periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 150K indicates strengthening labor demand, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tight periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 suggests weakening domestic supply capacity, reducing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals improving supply capacity, raising growth expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in home sales (HOUST) below 1.2M units indicates cooling housing demand, reducing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in softening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in home sales (HOUST) above 1.4M units indicates strengthening housing demand, boosting growth expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
